name: Vigilant rifleman
note: Kestrel exosuit body with Lance rifle in both fists, integral keyed footplate; sockets for helm and backpack.

name: Vigil helm
note: Line-standard helm: chevron split visor, keel crest, ear-pod fins; 1.6 mm D-flat peg.

name: Power pack
note: Spine power pack with twin manoeuvring nozzles; 2.0 mm D-flat peg.

name: 32 mm base
note: 32 mm round deck-plate base: keyed recess for the footplate, 5 x 2 mm magnet pocket vented to the rim.
